preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 3 and 70.

preconditions.expression: len(initial_positions) == 3 and all(1 <= pos <= n for pos in initial_positions)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly three initial positions, each between 1 and n.
The main diagonal of the matrix must be filled with '*' characters.

preconditions.expression: all(diag[i][j] == diag[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must be either '-1' indicating no solution, or a non-negative integer followed by the correct number of move descriptions.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(move, tuple) and len(move) == 2 and 1 <= move[0] <= n and 1 <= move[1] <= n for move in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each move description must be a tuple of two integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: any(all(diag[stones[i]][stones[j]] == diag[stones[j]][stones[k]] for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1, 3) for k in range(j+1, 3)) for stones in [initial_positions] + [tuple(sorted([move[1] for move in return_value[1:]]))])
postconditions.description: The stones must always be connected by diagonals of the same color.
After all moves, the stones must occupy vertices 1, 2, and 3.
